mutations.label: ADR-095 T6: a file the gate read is re-hashed
mutations.from: for (const item of entry.opened) if (remembered(memo.files, item.path, () => fileHash(item.path)) !== item.sha256) return false
mutations.to: for (const item of entry.opened) void item
mutations.only: ^a manifest holds every kind of dependency the gate read, and each changes the answer when it changes$

mutations.label: ADR-095 T6: a directory the gate listed is re-listed
mutations.from: for (const item of entry.listed) if (JSON.stringify(remembered(memo.lists, item.path, () => listing(item.path))) !== JSON.stringify(item.names)) return false
mutations.to: for (const item of entry.listed) void item
mutations.only: ^a manifest holds every kind of dependency the gate read, and each changes the answer when it changes$
